note: Every value here is published by the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) and WMO in the European State of the Climate 2025 report. `ratePerDecade` is the warming trend over the past ~30 years (since the mid-1990s). `abovePreIndustrial` is the latest five-year-average surface air temperature relative to the 1850-1900 pre-industrial baseline. Arctic figures are over land only, from ERA5. Nothing in this file is interpolated or estimated.
source: Copernicus Climate Change Service / WMO, European State of the Climate 2025
